project.title: PromptFM Public Roadmap & Community Board
project.description: Official public roadmap, milestone tracking, and active development board for the PromptFM autonomous 24/7 radio community.

milestones.title: v0.2.0 - Zero-Cost Infrastructure & Stream Server
milestones.description: GCP Always-Free VM, Icecast 2 streaming, Hostinger DNS, Terraform IaC, Vercel preview budget gating, and release automation.

milestones.title: v0.3.0 - Autonomous Playback & Station Clock Wheel
milestones.description: Continuous rotation engine, anti-repeat logic, DJ commentary transitions, station ID drops, and queue ETA synchronization.

milestones.title: v0.4.0 - Mobile Player Ergonomics & Multi-Channel UX
milestones.description: Sub-375px viewport layout, mobile slide-up controls drawer, public song list, playback progress, and light/dark theme switching.

milestones.title: v0.5.0 - Creator Community, Submissions & Safety Guardrails
milestones.description: Direct track uploading, first-login consent, creator identity, request lifecycle state machine, and automated Whisper/Gemini vocal ASR safety scanning.

milestones.title: v0.6.0 - Admin Studio, Web MCP & Observability
milestones.description: Interactive Web MCP console, Vercel Flags SDK kill switches, soft track deletion, channel administration, and realtime moderation queues.

milestones.title: v1.0.0 - Production Readiness, Bot Ecosystem & Scale
milestones.description: Discord slash commands, Telegram bridge, cross-platform mini-player, AdSense monetization, and public launch.
